strict_entry.title: STRICTER ENTRY.
strict_entry.doc: Momentum z of 1.5 and volatility expansion of 1.3x to open.

heavy_entry.title: HEAVIER VOLUME TO ENTER.
heavy_entry.doc: Relative volume of 2.5x for a tranche, 4x for two.

uptrend.title: UPTREND FILTER.
uptrend.doc: Opens only above a rising three-session average.
uptrend.filter:
closes = [float(c) for c in context.closes(symbol, 105)]
    if len(closes) < 105:
        return False
    now = sum(closes[-78:]) / 78
    before = sum(closes[-104:-26]) / 78
    return closes[-1] > now > before

no_distribution.title: NO DISTRIBUTION EXIT.
no_distribution.doc: No trimming on heavy volume into a down bar.

strict_uptrend.title: STRICTER ENTRY IN AN UPTREND.
strict_uptrend.doc: Both of the round-x1 entry fixes that each cut the loss: z 1.5 and expansion 1.3x, and only above a rising three-session average.
strict_uptrend.filter:
closes = [float(c) for c in context.closes(symbol, 105)]
    if len(closes) < 105:
        return False

all_entry.title: ALL THREE ENTRY FILTERS.
all_entry.doc: Stricter momentum and expansion, heavier volume, and the uptrend filter, all at once: the fewest, strongest entries.
all_entry.filter:
closes = [float(c) for c in context.closes(symbol, 105)]
    if len(closes) < 105:

three_leaders.title: THREE LEADERS, SMALLER.
three_leaders.doc: Holds the top three names at 27% each instead of two at 40%: more of a basket move, less on any one name.

tight_stop.title: TIGHTER STOP.
tight_stop.doc: The stop moves from 3 to 1.5 ATR. Almost every loser in round x1 was closed by the momentum exit at a small loss; this cuts them sooner.

no_momentum_exit.title: NO MOMENTUM EXIT.
no_momentum_exit.doc: Losers are no longer closed when momentum turns, only by the stop, rotation or distribution. The momentum exit closed about 50 trades in round x1 with a 2% win rate; this tests whether some of those would have recovered.
